direct.title: Direct connection

direct.description: Each slot request uses its own TLS connection, with automatic SSH fallback if it fails. kin-slot-gate listens on this port on the node. Allow only the control plane’s outbound IP through the node firewall.

name: Name
removeDescription: {{value1}} · {{value2}}. Disconnect SSH and remove local credentials and the Docker bridge. Remote containers keep running.

edit.name: Edit name

error.fingerprintMismatch: Host fingerprint mismatch. You can only update connection details for the same host here.
